## Problem and resulting behavior

The capability register still showed qualified work as pending, required the CLI's six jobs for every repository, and linked Access pull requests under the CLI repository. A delivery could also be relabeled across product layers.

This change reconciles nine verified source deliveries across 40 partial requirement rows and reports the verified canonical plugin package separately. Each component binds its repository/layer, PR, candidate and actual-main commits, ordered parents, equal trees, immutable workflow content, and complete candidate/main jobs. Historical Access workflows retain their actual two-, four- or five-job contracts; the CLI retains all six required jobs.

Normalized receipts are checked against retained GitHub source/run/job observations. Required identities, attempt numbers, API URLs and chronology must agree. Physical run/job identities cannot attest both phases. Duplicate row references, duplicate source PRs, duplicate saved packages, invalid supersession and substituted workflow/source evidence fail closed.

The saved plugin package binds its exact eight-file manifest and original readback time, with the later Access28 source reconciliation recorded separately. Its runtime/OAuth/UI/wrapper status remains explicitly unverified. Original failed and superseded evidence is retained.

MTR-METRIC-01 now names issue #255's four existing criteria and retains the prior generic wording in history. Independent review found its reporting/source scope eligible for implementation/test/merge credit after this corrected immutable source completes the normal gates. This candidate leaves all whole-requirement axes at zero; no inventory refresh or issue closure awards them.

Related: #255, #81, #136.

## Exact source and independent review

- Base: `6a6a883f3ce1cd86a7405d2c53a1fb08cd1210c2`
- Candidate: `bbcd446207aa1147bf924d8d397570dc987ac308`
- Tree: `62b35e966af7aaf8ea0b85e1db465a182369c640`
- All 63 uploaded file blobs and the full remote tree match the prepared local index.
- Frozen adversarial review: 46/46 focused tests, all 14 original mutations rejected, all nine real deliveries valid.
- Separate criterion review: all four issue255 criteria approved, all 43 consumed input hashes recomputed, all protected baseline ledgers unchanged.
- Criterion-review receipt SHA-256: `1136c26ad96b44dbdf403740915c08074993e903b9624480bf4c7d12eec277d7`.
- Receipts and lossless logs: `docs/validation/2026-11-12-delivery-accounting/`.

## Validation

| Check | Actual result |
| --- | --- |
| Initial repository-contract regressions | RED: 11 cases, 8 controls passed and 3 failed before repair |
| Captured identity/package regressions | RED: 3/3 selected cases failed before repair |
| Exact saved manifest regression | RED before repair |
| Independent boundary regressions | RED: 7/7 failed before repair |
| Corrected focused suites | 46/46 passed, no skips or cancellations |
| Normal build | Passed |
| Roadmap, parity, capabilities, typecheck and formatting | Passed |
| Complete ordinary local check | **Failed:** 1,543 tests; 1,504 passed, 27 unchanged isolation Unix-socket `listen EPERM` failures, 12 existing Windows-only skips, zero cancellations/TODOs |
| Six hosted candidate jobs and package/native gates | **PASS:** exact `bbcd4462`; runs 43322257308 and 43322257223; all six jobs and required steps successful |
| Actual-main qualification | In progress for normal merge `d430ec5e0d7dcefc041df4ab5f80cb32382c5ac3`; exact tree and ordered parents verified |

The full 756,905-byte failed check log is retained losslessly with raw/archive hashes. Its sole failing test file is byte-identical to base. No assertion, workflow or timeout was relaxed.

The original CLI300/DCP48/WEB12/AUG117 denominators, stages and weights remain unchanged. CLI maturity remains 29.36%, with zero of 300 complete. The reporting validator is a development-only tool; its evidence consistency checks require independent source and behavior review.

## Delivery authority and limits

The comprehensive owner mission and standing OWNER_AUTHORIZATION cover this scoped work and normal verified merge. All six exact-candidate checks, independent immutable-tree review, expected-head merge protection and actual-main qualification remain required. Runtime rollout, canonical-only OAuth, UI activation, wrapper removal and whole-mission acceptance require their own evidence.

## Evidence publication correction

Independent tree review found that Git ignore rules omitted two original log files referenced by the retained validation manifest from initial candidate `2206445c8498725f0f97098c83a4f21a7e0f69c9`. Successor `bbcd446207aa1147bf924d8d397570dc987ac308` adds the exact `build.log` and criterion `capability-check-final.log` bytes, updates the AI change file list, and removes its stale pending-check phrase. Reviewed validator, tests, register and generated outputs are unchanged. The initial candidate and its check history remain preserved; qualification must target the successor head above.

## Qualified candidate and normal merge

Independent exact-candidate receipt SHA-256: `20a245e216ee1fcaef96fa2ae3099b405384f6c79600ab3bb6553cba45c5a47f`. All six jobs passed. Windows passed 1,543/1,543; other ordinary lanes passed 1,531 plus 12 existing platform skips. All five installed-package lanes, four zero-model Codex parser/configuration lanes and 12 source plus 12 installed native isolation cases passed with cleanup verified.

Normal expected-head merge produced `d430ec5e0d7dcefc041df4ab5f80cb32382c5ac3`, tree `62b35e966af7aaf8ea0b85e1db465a182369c640`, ordered parents `6a6a883f3ce1cd86a7405d2c53a1fb08cd1210c2` and `bbcd446207aa1147bf924d8d397570dc987ac308`. Fresh actual-main checks remain a separate gate and are being qualified.

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# AI-Change: 2026-10-21-orchestrator-ready (OpenAI / GPT-6)
name: CLI fast checks
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: cli-fast-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  fast:
    name: CI / fast
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 12
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with:
          node-version: '24.21.0'
          cache: npm
      - name: Reproducible install without lifecycle scripts
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Pinned reviewed build
        run: npm run build
      - name: Deterministic tests
        run: npm run check
      - name: No test-induced source mutation
        run: git diff --exit-code

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# AI-Change: 2026-10-05-codex-parity-foundation
name: CLI compatibility foundation
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main, 'feat/**']
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: cli-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  verify:
    name: ${{ matrix.os }} / Node 24
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: windows-2022
            platform: win32
            arch: x64
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            platform: linux
            arch: x64
          # macos-14 retired 2026-11-02; preserve the explicit ARM64 lane on a supported image.
          - os: macos-15
            platform: darwin
            arch: arm64
          - os: macos-15-intel
            platform: darwin
            arch: x64
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with:
          node-version: '24.21.0'
      - name: Verify actual runtime architecture
        run: node -e "const a=require('node:assert/strict');a.equal(process.platform,process.env.EXPECT_PLATFORM);a.equal(process.arch,process.env.EXPECT_ARCH);console.log(JSON.stringify({node:process.version,platform:process.platform,arch:process.arch}))"
        env:
          EXPECT_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}
          EXPECT_ARCH: ${{ matrix.arch }}
      - name: Reproducible dependencies without lifecycle side effects
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Reviewed source and pinned parity baseline
        run: npm run build
      - name: Typecheck formatting and deterministic tests
        run: npm run check
      - name: Verify packed install and isolated npm link
        run: node scripts/verify-package.mjs
      - name: Install pinned Codex into test-owned prefix
        run: npm install --prefix artifacts/ci-codex --no-audit --no-fund --ignore-scripts --package-lock=false @openai/codex@0.160.1
      - name: Real Codex registration without login or model calls
        run: node scripts/verify-managed-codex.mjs
        env:
          MTERM_CODEX_TEST_PREFIX: artifacts/ci-codex
          MTERM_CODEX_EXPECTED_VERSION: '0.160.1'
      - name: Exact source remains unchanged by tests
        run: git diff --exit-code
  isolation-linux:
    name: Native Linux isolation / Node 24
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with:
          node-version: '24.21.0'
      - name: Reproducible dependencies and reviewed source
        run: |
          npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          npm run build
      - name: Prepare signed pinned runtime on the disposable runner
        run: node scripts/prepare-isolation-ci.mjs
      - name: Mandatory real source containment and cleanup
        run: node scripts/verify-isolation-live.mjs
        env:
          MTERM_ISOLATION_REQUIRE_LIVE: '1'
      - name: Mandatory actual installed-package containment and cleanup
        run: node scripts/verify-package.mjs
        env:
          MTERM_ISOLATION_REQUIRE_LIVE: '1'
      - name: Exact source remains unchanged by live tests
        run: git diff --exit-code
      - name: Retain qualification evidence even after a failed gate
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
        with:
          name: aug005-linux-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: artifacts/aug005/ci-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
          overwrite: false
          include-hidden-files: false
